name: USDOT National Address Database (NAD)

rights.license: Presumed Public Domain (federal aggregation) -- NOT directly confirmed

notes: The primary disclaimer/rights page returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch attempts (tried two mirrors); the public-domain conclusion here is reconstructed from secondary/cached summaries only, not a direct primary-source read -- treat as unconfirmed. Additional nuance even if the federal compilation itself is public domain: NAD aggregates state/local/tribal-submitted address data, and USDOT does not appear to assert it has independently cleared rights on every contributing sub-source. Also flag a NON-copyright usage restriction the disclaimer reportedly states: the data is 'not intended for use as a mailing list' and may be subject to individual state statutes restricting that specific use -- record this separately from the license determination if/when this source is approved, since it's a use restriction rather than a copyright term.
